_what: Decision-level reconstruction uncertainty on the real stacchiotti2013 Fig. 2 reading, and held-out validation against printed numbers-at-risk.
_not_medical_advice: Nothing here is medical advice and nothing asserts efficacy, safety or clinical readiness. Every number is a re-expression of an already-published figure.

external_check.⭐: This is the ONLY check in this program that tests the READING rather than the arithmetic: the paper states a number the reconstruction must land on, and the reconstruction never sees it.

decision_band.⚠: A range over variants of one reading of one figure of one 11-patient series. It is not a confidence interval and it is not a cohort statistic.
